comparison.objective: Retrieve diagonal cutters from a crowded pegboard and place them on a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Clutter-aware grasping and lift-then-pull hook clearance; no adjuster, fastener, or dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Cutters stable over the mat with no other tool fallen; dropping any tool off the table fails.
comparison.reason: Tests safe tool retrieval from an upturned peg.
